cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Miss the prize ceremony and come to my tiny opening night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'll pick you up and save you a front-row seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can leave after the curtain call. Will you miss their applause to be there for mine?

reason: Reread found leaving at curtain call could remove B before the applause A requests. Change to after, preserving the bounded stay and real sacrificed ceremony.
